# Scripts

Entry points in `scripts/`, run from the repo root with `uv run python scripts/<name>.py` (`--help` lists the options). Exit codes: 0 ok (Ctrl-C too), 1 crash, 2 configuration error, 3 another instance holds this environment's state directory.

| Script | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `bench_decision_models.py` | Decision-model CPU benchmark (plan M7.4): load time, resident memory and p50/p95 latency of each Laya checkpoint on this machine, for one question and for five questions per state. |
| `build_decision_labels.py` | Build the labelled announcement set for decision-model calibration (plan M7.5). |
| `build_demo_tape.py` | (Re)write the demo's bundled fixture tape, ``src/engine/demo_tape/`` (plan M9.6), from the deterministic generator in ``src/engine/demo.py``. Only needed after changing the generator; ``tests/test_demo_tape.py`` fails until the committed tape matches it again. |
| `calibrate_decision_models.py` | Fit and report decision-model calibration (plan M7.5) on the labelled announcement set. |
| `check_config.py` | Readiness check: environment and state directory, enabled LLM roles (exit 2 if one is misconfigured), Dhan and Telegram status, and configuration warnings. Never prints a secret. |
| `daily_report.py` | Regenerate the daily report (plan M8.4) for any recorded day from the environment's event store. |
| `export_openapi.py` | Write the web API's OpenAPI document to ``frontend/openapi.json`` (plan M9.5). The frontend's types are generated from it (``cd frontend && npm run gen:api`` → ``src/api/types.gen.ts``); CI fails when either file is stale. |
| `fetch_bhavcopy.py` | Build the point-in-time daily dataset from NSE's UDiFF capital-market bhavcopies (plan M11.3). |
| `gen_docs.py` | Generate the reference half of the docs from the code (plan M12.3) into ``docs/reference/``. |
| `llm_check.py` | LLM connectivity check (plan M6): one tiny schema-validated call per **enabled** role, through the real router (fallbacks, budgets, breakers; the reply cache is bypassed), recorded as ``LLMCall`` events in the environment's store. Prints, per role:: |
| `nightly_review.py` | Nightly post-trade review (plan M8.7): role ``review`` writes structured lessons for each trade closed on the day; stored as ``TradeReview`` events, never fed back into any book in month 1. The engine already runs it after the daily report; use this to (re)run it for a day. |
| `replay_day.py` | Replay a recorded day through the engine (plan M8.5): the day's tape, the reference snapshots cached for it, the announcements the live run stored, and cached LLM and decision-model responses (no network). Writes a fresh event store and the day's report. |
| `run_live_trading.py` | RakshaQuant — main entry point. |
| `setup.py` | Guided one-command setup for RakshaQuant. |
| `test_dhan_connection.py` | DhanHQ Connection Test |
| `validate_strategy.py` | Validate strategies before risking capital (plan M11.2): backtest the paper engine itself over daily history (``src/backtesting/session.py``) and apply the edge gate (``src/backtesting/edge.py``): VALIDATED needs at least 200 closed trades **and** a 95% bootstrap CI of the mean net return per trade above zero. |
